13. Token Reference

Every token, with its custom property, its value in light and dark, and what it is for. build.mjs writes the tables below from src/tokens.source.json; tokens/tokens.json holds the same tokens in the Design Tokens format, and tokens/tokens.mjs the public ones as an ES module.

How Tokens Are Named

  • Every custom property starts with --nc-, so it cannot meet a host page's own properties, Starlight's (--sl-) or Material UI's (--mui-).
  • A color role is --nc-color-<role>, written once: as light-dark(<light>, <dark>) where the themes differ, and as one value where they don't. A type role is --nc-type-<role>, with -stretch and -tracking beside it, and -case where it sets one. Elevation is --nc-elevation-<depth>.
  • A scale is numbered where its steps are a ramp, such as --nc-space-3, and named where its parts are few and fixed, such as --nc-radius-control and --nc-dur-press.

The Two Tiers

Semantic tokens are public: renaming or removing one, or changing what it is for, is a major version. Primitives are private: the color ramps and the steps of the type scale exist so the roles can be built from them, and may change in any release. Read a role instead: a color role for a ramp step, a type role for a size or a weight. This repository's own stylesheets read primitives, because they release with them (the decision).

Tenant inputs

Public.

Custom propertyValueWhat it is
--nc-brand#0033CCprimaryColor: what you press. Keys, links, focus, selection.
--nc-brand-secondary#0033CCsecondaryColor: what you are shown. Screens and the tenant's scope braces. It follows the primary until a tenant sets it.
